nodes.label: D-028 Evidence is the product; calculation is where the engineer does it
nodes.source_file: docs/releases/v1.0.0/D-028 Evidence is the product, calculation is where the engineer does it.md
nodes.rationale: Design-freeze review found about a third of the programme was a calculation tool competing with Excel/Mathcad/SMath and holding the highest-risk WP (a frozen grammar before its parser); every evidence capability already exists in the substrate; an evidence-centred definition removes PLM drift structurally.

nodes.label: TempestOS v1.0 is a client project system of record that evidence is tagged to
nodes.source_file: docs/releases/v1.0.0/D-028 Evidence is the product, calculation is where the engineer does it.md
nodes.rationale: Calculations done wherever the engineer does them; Tempest records the result as evidence with citations, key figures, independent check and issue. Nothing new computes in Tempest in v1.0.

nodes.label: TempestOS is not an ERP and not a PLM
nodes.source_file: docs/releases/v1.0.0/D-028 Evidence is the product, calculation is where the engineer does it.md
nodes.rationale: Product structure stays a single-parent tree used as tags; no occurrence model, change control, procurement, supplier, cost or stock field, no workflow engine; an attribute earns its place only if a calc sheet cites it, a title block shows it, or the invoice seam needs it.
